title: Hotel Rate Plans: Date Changes and Lead Guest Changes, Plan by Plan
content:
Whether a Hotel Rate Plans reservation may be moved or renamed at all, how often, and at what fee, is recorded against the plan booked.

| Rate plan | Dates may be moved | Date-change fee, USD | Maximum number of date changes | Lead guest may be replaced | Name-change fee, USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | no | 0.0 | 0 | no | 0.0 |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | yes | 75.0 | 1 | no | 0.0 |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | yes | 45.0 | 2 | yes | 35.0 |
| Standard Flexible Rate | yes | 0.0 | 4 | yes | 25.0 |
| Member Flex Rate | yes | 0.0 | 4 | yes | 0.0 |
| Suite Flexible Rate | yes | 35.0 | 3 | yes | 25.0 |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | yes | 95.0 | 2 | no | 0.0 |

## How the columns divide the plans

Six of the seven plans allow the stay dates to be moved; only the Non-Refundable Saver Rate does not, and it records a ceiling of 0 date changes to match. Two plans charge nothing to move dates, the Standard Flexible Rate and the Member Flex Rate, and the dearest move is the 95.0 USD the All-Inclusive Flex Rate records. The ceiling on moves runs from 1 on the Advance Purchase 21 Rate to 4 on the Standard Flexible Rate and the Member Flex Rate.

Four plans allow the lead guest to be replaced. Of those, the Member Flex Rate charges nothing, the Standard Flexible Rate and the Suite Flexible Rate charge 25.0 USD, and the Semi-Flexible Rate charges 35.0 USD. The three plans that do not allow a replacement record a name-change fee of 0.0 USD, which is not a free name change but the absence of a priced one.
